<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Hospital Medication Inventory System</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1b2456; --navy-2:#2b3579; --lav:#8d93c9; --lav-2:#b7bbe3;
    --bg-1:#4a5190; --bg-2:#9397c4; --panel:#eef0f8; --white:#ffffff;
    --ok:#1f8a4c; --warn:#c8631c; --crit:#b23321; --ink:#1b2456;
    --line:#c7cae4;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;margin:0;}
  body{
    font-family:'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; color:var(--ink);
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg-1),var(--bg-2));
    min-height:100%;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.serif{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;}

  /* ---------- LOGIN ---------- */
  #view-login{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;}
  .login-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:18px;padding:36px 32px;width:360px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35);text-align:center;}
  .emblem{width:70px;height:auto;object-fit:contain;}
  .emblem-badge{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;
    border:2px solid var(--navy);border-radius:50%/35%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#fff,#dfe2f2);
    padding:10px 14px 12px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #fff;}
  .emblem-badge .r1{font-size:10px;color:var(--navy);margin-top:2px;}
  .emblem-badge .r2{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:.3px;}
  .login-card .emblem-badge{margin:0 auto 12px;}
  header.topbar .emblem-badge{padding:6px 10px 8px;}
  header.topbar .emblem{width:40px;height:auto;}
  header.topbar .emblem-badge .r1{font-size:7.5px;}
  header.topbar .emblem-badge .r2{font-size:8px;}
  .login-card h1{font-size:18px;margin:4px 0 2px;letter-spacing:.3px;}
  .login-card .sub{font-size:12px;color:#555;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .field{text-align:left;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .field label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#444;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .field select,.field input{width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;background:#fbfbfe;}
  .btn-primary{width:100%;padding:11px;border:none;border-radius:999px;background:var(--navy);
    color:#fff;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px;font-size:13px;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--navy-2);}
  .hint{font-size:10.5px;color:#888;margin-top:14px;}

  /* ---------- APP SHELL ---------- */
  #view-app{display:none;min-height:100vh;}
  header.topbar{background:var(--white);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
    padding:12px 20px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--navy);}
  header.topbar .emblem{width:46px;height:46px;flex:none;}
  header.topbar .title{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  header.topbar .title h1{font-size:15px;margin:0;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:.3px;}
  header.topbar .title p{font-size:10px;margin:1px 0 0;color:#666;}
  .role-pills{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .role-pill{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--navy);
    background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}
  .role-pill.active{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;}

  .layout{display:flex;min-height:calc(100vh - 70px);}
  nav.side{width:190px;flex:none;background:var(--navy);padding:16px 10px;}
  nav.side a{display:block;color:#dfe1f5;text-decoration:none;font-size:12.5px;
    padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:4px;cursor:pointer;}
  nav.side a.active{background:var(--navy-2);color:#fff;font-weight:700;}
  nav.side a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  main.content{flex:1;background:var(--panel);padding:18px;overflow-x:auto;}

  .page{display:none;}
  .page.active{display:block;}
  .page h2{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--navy);}
  .page .desc{font-size:11.5px;color:#555;margin:0 0 16px;}

  /* KPI ovals */
  .kpi-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .kpi{background:var(--white);border:2px solid var(--navy);border-radius:999px;
    padding:8px 18px;text-align:center;min-width:110px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
  .kpi .lbl{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;}
  .kpi .val{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px;}
  .kpi.ok .val{color:var(--ok);} .kpi.warn .val{color:var(--warn);} .kpi.crit .val{color:var(--crit);}

  .grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
  .card{background:var(--white);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
  .card h3{font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--navy);}

  .bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:120px;}
  .bars .bar{flex:1;background:var(--navy-2);border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;position:relative;}
  .bars .bar span{position:absolute;bottom:-16px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:8.5px;color:#666;}

  .hbar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:10.5px;}
  .hbar-row .name{width:92px;flex:none;color:#444;}
  .hbar-row .track{flex:1;background:#e3e5f3;border-radius:4px;height:10px;overflow:hidden;}
  .hbar-row .fill{height:100%;background:var(--lav);}
  .hbar-row .n{width:38px;text-align:right;color:#555;}

  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11.5px;}
  th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;text-align:left;padding:8px;font-size:10.5px;}
  td{padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#f5f6fb;}
  .badge{padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;}
  .badge.ok{background:var(--ok);} .badge.warn{background:var(--warn);} .badge.crit{background:var(--crit);}

  .toolbar{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .toolbar input,.toolbar select{padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-size:11.5px;}

  .dispense-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;max-width:640px;}
  .btn-sm{padding:8px 16px;border:none;border-radius:999px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;
    font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;}
  .note{background:#fff8e6;border:1px solid #e9d28a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11px;margin-top:10px;}
  .stub{background:var(--white);border-radius:10px;padding:30px;text-align:center;color:#666;font-size:12.5px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ===== LOGIN SCREEN ===== -->
<div id="view-login">
  <div class="login-card">
    <div class="emblem-badge">
      <img class="emblem" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Coat of arms of Botswana">
      <div class="r1">Republic of Botswana</div>
      <div class="r2">MINISTRY OF HEALTH</div>
    </div>
    <h1 class="serif">HOSPITAL MEDICATION<br>INVENTORY SYSTEM</h1>
    <p class="sub">Republic of Botswana &middot; Ministry of Health</p>
    <div class="field"><label>Role</label>
      <select id="loginRole">
        <option value="admin">Administrator</option>
        <option value="pharm">Pharmacist / Dispensary Officer</option>
        <option value="nurse">Nurse</option>
        <option value="inv">Inventory Officer</option>
        <option value="audit">Auditor</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="field"><label>Username</label><input placeholder="e.g. k.ndlovu"></div>
    <div class="field"><label>Password</label><input type="password" placeholder="••••••••"></div>
    <button class="btn-primary" onclick="login()">SIGN IN</button>
    <p class="hint">Mockup prototype &mdash; sign-in is not authenticated</p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== MAIN APP ===== -->
<div id="view-app">
  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="emblem-badge">
      <img class="emblem" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Coat of arms of Botswana">
      <div class="r1">Republic of Botswana</div>
      <div class="r2">MINISTRY OF HEALTH</div>
    </div>
    <div class="title">
      <h1>HOSPITAL MEDICATION INVENTORY SYSTEM</h1>
      <p>Princess Marina Hospital &middot; Ministry of Health, Botswana</p>
    </div>
    <div class="role-pills" id="rolePills"></div>
  </header>

  <div class="layout">
    <nav class="side" id="sideNav"></nav>
    <main class="content">

      <section class="page" id="page-dashboard">
        <h2>Dashboard</h2>
        <p class="desc" id="dashWelcome"></p>
        <div class="kpi-row" id="kpiRow"></div>
        <div class="grid-2">
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Monthly Consumption</h3>
            <div class="bars" id="barsChart"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Top Consumed Medicines</h3>
            <div id="topMeds"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="page" id="page-inventory">
        <h2>Inventory</h2>
        <p class="desc">Individual-unit stock levels across all medication items.</p>
        <div class="toolbar">
          <input placeholder="Search medicine...">
          <select><option>All categories</option><option>Antihypertensives</option><option>Antimalarials</option><option>ARVs</option></select>
          <select><option>All statuses</option><option>OK</option><option>Warning</option><option>Critical</option></select>
        </div>
        <table>
          <tr><th>Medicine</th><th>Batch</th><th>Expiry</th><th>Units in Stock</th><th>Reorder Level</th><th>Status</th></tr>
          <tr><td>Amoxicillin 500mg</td><td>BX1182</td><td>2027-03-11</td><td>5,460</td><td>2,000</td><td><span class="badge ok">OK</span></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Insulin Actrapid</td><td>IN0043</td><td>2026-12-02</td><td>180</td><td>250</td><td><span class="badge warn">Warning</span></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Ceftriaxone 1g Injection</td><td>CF7701</td><td>2026-10-19</td><td>42</td><td>200</td><td><span class="badge crit">Critical</span></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Metformin 500mg</td><td>MT3390</td><td>2027-06-30</td><td>3,120</td><td>1,500</td><td><span class="badge ok">OK</span></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Tenofovir 300mg</td><td>TV5521</td><td>2026-11-05</td><td>610</td><td>600</td><td><span class="badge warn">Warning</span></td></tr>
        </table>
      </section>

      <section class="page" id="page-dispensing">
        <h2>Dispensing</h2>
        <p class="desc">Convert packs to individual units and record a dispensing transaction.</p>
        <div class="dispense-grid card">
          <div class="field"><label>Patient / Collection Reference</label><input placeholder="e.g. PMH-00441"></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Medicine</label>
            <select><option>Amoxicillin 500mg</option><option>Metformin 500mg</option><option>Tenofovir 300mg</option></select></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Pack size</label><input value="30 tablets" disabled></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Units to dispense</label><input id="dispQty" type="number" value="20"></div>
          <div class="field" style="grid-column:1/-1">
            <button class="btn-sm" onclick="doDispense()">Record Dispensing</button>
            <span id="dispResult" style="margin-left:10px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="note">Remaining pack units return to stock automatically (e.g. 30-tablet pack &minus; 20 dispensed = 10 remaining units retained).</div>
      </section>

      <section class="page" id="page-collections">
        <h2>Patient Collections</h2>
        <p class="desc">Chronic patients scheduled to collect medication, for proactive preparation.</p>
        <table>
          <tr><th>Patient Ref</th><th>Medicine</th><th>Scheduled Date</th><th>Status</th></tr>
          <tr><td>PMH-00112</td><td>Metformin 500mg</td><td>Today</td><td><span class="badge warn">Due</span></td></tr>
          <tr><td>PMH-00287</td><td>Tenofovir 300mg</td><td>Tomorrow</td><td><span class="badge ok">Scheduled</span></td></tr>
          <tr><td>PMH-00356</td><td>Insulin Actrapid</td><td>In 3 days</td><td><span class="badge ok">Scheduled</span></td></tr>
        </table>
      </section>

      <section class="page" id="page-users">
        <h2>Users</h2>
        <div class="stub">User account management &mdash; add, deactivate and assign roles (Administrator, Pharmacist, Nurse, Inventory Officer, Auditor).</div>
      </section>

      <section class="page" id="page-audit">
        <h2>Audit Log</h2>
        <div class="stub">Tamper-resistant log of every stock change: who, what, when. Filterable by user, date range and action type.</div>
      </section>

      <section class="page" id="page-reports">
        <h2>Reports</h2>
        <div class="stub">Exportable stockout, wastage and consumption reports by ward, category and date range.</div>
      </section>

    </main>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const ROLES = {
  admin:{label:'Administrator', nav:['dashboard','inventory','dispensing','collections','users','audit','reports'],
    kpis:[['Total Items','26','ok'],['OK Items','6','ok'],['Warning Items','13','warn'],['Critical Items','7','crit'],['% At Risk','76.9%','crit']]},
  pharm:{label:'Pharmacist / Dispensary Officer', nav:['dashboard','dispensing','inventory','collections'],
    kpis:[["Today's Dispensed",'142','ok'],['Pending Collections','9','warn'],['Low-Stock Alerts','4','crit'],['Patients Served','58','ok']]},
  nurse:{label:'Nurse', nav:['dashboard','collections'],
    kpis:[['Due Today','5','warn'],['Due This Week','21','ok'],['Missed Collections','2','crit']]},
  inv:{label:'Inventory Officer', nav:['dashboard','inventory','reports'],
    kpis:[['Total Items','26','ok'],['Warning Items','13','warn'],['Critical Items','7','crit'],['Items Entering Critical (30d)','11','warn']]},
  audit:{label:'Auditor', nav:['dashboard','audit','reports'],
    kpis:[['Transactions Logged','3,214','ok'],['Flagged Entries','3','crit'],['Active Users','18','ok']]}
};
const NAV_LABEL = {dashboard:'Dashboard',inventory:'Inventory',dispensing:'Dispensing',
  collections:'Patient Collections',users:'Users',audit:'Audit Log',reports:'Reports'};
const MONTHS=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
const VALS=[33,28,31,36,36,29,34,31,30,31,35,38];
const TOPMEDS=[['Prednisolone 5mg',15900],['Insulin Actrapid',15800],['Ceftriaxone 1g',14800],
  ['Amoxicillin 500mg',14600],['Enalapril 10mg',14300]];

let currentRole='admin';

function renderRolePills(){
  document.getElementById('rolePills').innerHTML = Object.keys(ROLES).map(r=>
    `<span class="role-pill ${r===currentRole?'active':''}" onclick="switchRole('${r}')">${ROLES[r].label}</span>`).join('');
}
function renderNav(){
  const pages = ROLES[currentRole].nav;
  document.getElementById('sideNav').innerHTML = pages.map((p,i)=>
    `<a class="${i===0?'active':''}" data-page="${p}" onclick="goPage('${p}',this)">${NAV_LABEL[p]}</a>`).join('');
  pages.forEach((p,i)=>document.getElementById('page-'+p).classList.toggle('active', i===0));
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(el=>{ if(!pages.includes(el.id.replace('page-',''))) el.classList.remove('active'); });
}
function renderDashboard(){
  document.getElementById('dashWelcome').textContent = `Signed in as ${ROLES[currentRole].label}.`;
  document.getElementById('kpiRow').innerHTML = ROLES[currentRole].kpis.map(k=>
    `<div class="kpi ${k[2]}"><div class="lbl">${k[0]}</div><div class="val">${k[1]}</div></div>`).join('');
  const max=Math.max(...VALS);
  document.getElementById('barsChart').innerHTML = VALS.map((v,i)=>
    `<div class="bar" style="height:${v/max*100}%"><span>${MONTHS[i]}</span></div>`).join('');
  const tmax = TOPMEDS[0][1];
  document.getElementById('topMeds').innerHTML = TOPMEDS.map(m=>
    `<div class="hbar-row"><div class="name">${m[0]}</div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${m[1]/tmax*100}%"></div></div><div class="n">${m[1].toLocaleString()}</div></div>`).join('');
}
function switchRole(r){ currentRole=r; renderRolePills(); renderNav(); renderDashboard(); }
function goPage(p, el){
  document.querySelectorAll('#sideNav a').forEach(a=>a.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('page-'+p).classList.add('active');
}
function login(){
  currentRole = document.getElementById('loginRole').value;
  document.getElementById('view-login').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('view-app').style.display='block';
  renderRolePills(); renderNav(); renderDashboard();
}
function doDispense(){
  const q = document.getElementById('dispQty').value;
  document.getElementById('dispResult').textContent = `Recorded: ${q} units dispensed, remainder returned to stock.`;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
